summary.answer: Return no values when parent is absent or first child is falsy. Otherwise start accumulated width at 0 and traverse getNextSibling until nil. Only visible (alpha>0), non-skipHorizontalLayout children enter the work block. Only a truthy customGetWidth member leads to its colon call and width accumulation. If that return is falsy the branch is empty. If truthy and targetLeft/targetWidth differ, beginAnimation(arg1) only when targetLeft differs, then setLeftRight(0,0,sum,sum+width) and cache both target fields; accumulate the custom width even when cached targets already match. After the custom branch always read getWidth into f17_local2 but never use that value for accumulation. Finally set container width to the sum. No normal getWidth fallback layout/accumulation is recovered; preserve that literal defect. Store exact global CoD.FreeCursorUtility.GetWidthByVisibleChildrenWidth into arg0.
